# Wharf 0.14.0 research

## Scope

Session 14 adds read-only run status, graceful stop with targeted ephemeral
cleanup, and durable completion/blocked notifications.

## Decisions

- Build status snapshots purely from retained events and supplied live
  occupancy; status reads do not rewrite state.
- Cancel the run first, wait through a bounded graceful window, and clean only
  explicitly supplied ephemeral resource IDs after timeout.
- Keep retained evidence outside cleanup inputs.
- Always persist completion and blocked notifications; webhook delivery is an
  optional explicit HTTPS sink.

## Deferred

Score computation, final report styling, and cross-run comparison remain later
sessions.
